title: Ambient Decapod backend handoff to Dactyl
intent: When Decapod resolves repo.backend=local or cloud, establish Dactyl's ambient DATASTORE, DATASTORE_ROUTE, and DATASTORE_TOKEN process inputs, then construct Dactyl from that ambient route while forwarding the opaque StorageContext unchanged. Keep Dactyl provider-neutral and preserve its minimal execution API; retain hosted Neon/Vercel parity as a separate downstream proof gate.
proof_hooks: cargo fmt --all -- --check; cargo test --lib dactyl; cargo test --test cloud_dactyl_boundary; cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings; decapod validate
stop_conditions: Do not add provider, tenant, repository, authorization, retry, idempotency, schema, migration, or governance semantics to Dactyl or the Decapod bridge.
Do not claim hosted parity from local or wire-level tests.
Keep local backend initialization free of cloud route or bearer state; clear stale cloud ambient variables when selecting local.
deferred_questions: Protected deployed Neon/Vercel parity, cross-organization isolation, and live cleanup remain downstream proof gates requiring operator-selected credentials.

phases.name: Contract and issue reconciliation
phases.description: Review live Decapod dactyl/propodus issues and freeze the Dactyl generic query/context boundary.

phases.name: Cloud todo Dactyl adapter
phases.description: Route backend=cloud todo commands through Propodus auth and Dactyl query/batch operations with local/protocol proof.

phases.name: Validation and publication
phases.description: Refresh living specs and governance artifacts, run local checks, publish one PR, and report hosted proof limits.
